toegepas.voor: Die verlede is verby en ons kan
toegepas.na: Die verlede is verby, en ons kan
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two sentences with their own subjects (die verlede / ons) and verbs.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects and verbs (die verlede is / ons kan).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two full sentences joined by 'en' take the AWS comma, and nothing else changes.

toegepas.voor: 'n Ou foto bly oor en 'n ou pot
toegepas.na: 'n Ou foto bly oor, en 'n ou pot
toegepas.rede_vinder: AWS comma: 'en' joins two full sentences, each with its own subject and verb.
toegepas.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subjects and verbs ('n ou foto bly / 'n ou pot bly).
toegepas.rede_keurder: Two full sentences joined by 'en' take the AWS comma, and nothing else changes.

toegepas.voor: wat ons vanuit bronne kan uitvind
toegepas.na: wat ons uit bronne kan uitvind
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'uit' is the natural, simpler preposition here; 'vanuit' is stiff and over-used for English 'from'.
toegepas.fout: 'vanuit' is stiff here, a loose copy of English 'from'; Afrikaans uses plain 'uit' for getting information out of sources.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'uit bronne' means exactly the same (information taken from sources) and is the natural Grade 4 wording, though if this sentence is a decided shared definition the guard will refuse it and send it to the writer.

laat_vaar.rede_vinder: No comma before 'en' in a list under the AWS rule the lesson follows.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: This is not a simple list: the comma separates the second 'en' from the nested 'visuele, mondelinge en geskrewe leidrade', which shows the reader there are four groups; without it, 'geskrewe' can seem to modify 'voorwerpbronne' as well and a child may count three.

vlae.teks: Vier van daardie groepe is visuele, mondelinge en geskrewe leidrade, en voorwerpbronne.
vlae.rede: The protected entry for 'voorwerpbronne' says the name ends on 'bronne' so the four types read as one set beside 'visuele, geskrewe en mondelinge bronne', but this sentence names the other three 'leidrade', so the set does not read as one; a terminology choice for the writer, not a language edit.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Asked for explicitly: the compound is well formed and transparent (voorwerp + bronne, like 'mondelinge bronne' made into one word), and a nine-year-old who knows 'voorwerp' and 'bron' will understand it; it reads as acceptable Afrikaans even if it is not attested in sources. No change proposed.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Soms wys hulle nie genoeg nie en die vraag bly oop.
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Under the AWS rule the lesson follows this needs a comma before 'en' (two subjects, hulle / die vraag, each with a verb); not changed because the sentence is protected.

Standard Afrikaans is ''n vraag beantwoord' (or 'antwoord op 'n vraag'); transitive 'n vraag antwoord' leans on English. The same form appears in the 'Wat 'n leidraad is' block and the 'bewys' glossary entry; left alone so all three stay consistent with the protected wording, but a person may want 'help beantwoord' throughout.
